newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BETIS CLOSE ON TROUBLED BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BETIS CLOSE ON TROUBLED BARCELONA.

text.p: Real Betis regained third place in the Spanish league on Sunday thanks to goals from strikers Alfonso Perez and Finidi George in a 2-1 home win over struggling Hercules.

A win on Thursday at Sporting Gijon in a game postponed from January would take Betis level on points with second-placed Barcelona, who crashed 4-0 at Tenerife on Saturday. Leaders Real Madrid, a further six points ahead, play Espanyol on Monday.

Extremadura continued their extraordinary recovery with a 3-2 win at Racing Santander, while Zaragoza clawed their way out of the relegation zone for the first time in nearly four months by beating Valladolid 1-0.
The results opened up a five-point gap between Extremadura and bottom-but-one club Sevilla, who went down 3-2 to reigning champions Atletico Madrid on Saturday.
Hercules bring up the rear a further two points back and look almost certain to go straight back to the second division at the end of the season.
